title: The bZIP24-bZIP53 transcription factor complex regulates kaempferol 3-O-rutinoside biosynthesis in Rubus chingii by targeting 1,6-rhamnosyltransferase.
authors: Shi, Yujie; Shen, Mingkai; Wei, Lijuan; Li, Qianfan; Hao, Yue; Qin, Zhengchen; Sun, Jian; Jiang, Jingyong; Chen, Zhen; Zeng, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究R. chingii中bZIP24-bZIP53转录因子复合物调控K3R生物合成，通过Y1H和双荧光素酶实验验证TF与启动子结合，但缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，仅涉及TF-DNA结合实验验证，与课题方法轴不匹配。
abstract: Rubus chingii, a plant celebrated for its dual role as medicine and food, contains kaempferol 3-O-rutinoside (K3R) as a principal bioactive flavonol glycoside. Yet, the K3R biosynthetic pathway in this species, particularly the crucial final glycosylation step, remains poorly characterized. Our investigation identified 172 UGTs within the R. chingii genome, pinpointing 18 candidate UGTs potentially involved in K3R synthesis. Phylogenetic and expression analyses revealed that three flavonol 3-glucosyltransferases (RcUGT87, RcUGT89, RcUGT169) and eight flavonol 1,6-rhamnosyltransferases (RcUGT7, RcUGT13, RcUGT27, RcUGT72, RcUGT73, RcUGT97, RcUGT166, RcUGT160) exhibited high expression in green fruits. Enzyme activity assays confirmed RcUGT169 as the most active 3GlcT, efficiently converting kaempferol to K3G, and identified RcUGT27 as the key 1,6RhaT, synthesizing K3R from K3G. Molecular docking highlighted Asp-210, Glu-203, and Leu-204 as critical residues underpinning RcUGT27 activity. Y1H and dual luciferase assays demonstrated that transcription factors (TFs) RcWHY1 and RcbZIP24/44/53 directly bind the RcUGT27 promoter, driving its expression; notably, RcbZIP24 and RcbZIP53 form a complex to amplify this regulation. Hormone treatments showed ABA and MeJA significantly induce RcUGT27 expression through these TFs. This study establishes a comprehensive regulatory network governing K3R biosynthesis in R. chingii, offering valuable insights to guide future molecular breeding strategies and industrial production.
abstract_zh: 掌叶覆盆子（Rubus chingii）作为一种兼具药用与食用双重价值的植物，其含有的山柰酚3-O-芸香糖苷（kaempferol 3-O-rutinoside, K3R）是主要的生物活性黄酮醇糖苷。然而，该物种中K3R的生物合成途径，尤其是关键的最终糖基化步骤，仍缺乏充分表征。本研究在掌叶覆盆子基因组中鉴定出172个UGT，并筛选出18个可能参与K3R合成的候选UGT。系统发育和表达分析显示，三个黄酮醇3-葡萄糖基转移酶（RcUGT87、RcUGT89、RcUGT169）和八个黄酮醇1,6-鼠李糖基转移酶（RcUGT7、RcUGT13、RcUGT27、RcUGT72、RcUGT73、RcUGT97、RcUGT166、RcUGT160）在青果中高表达。酶活性测定证实RcUGT169是最活跃的3GlcT，能高效将山柰酚转化为K3G，并鉴定RcUGT27为关键的1,6RhaT，负责从K3G合成K3R。分子对接揭示Asp-210、Glu-203和Leu-204是支撑RcUGT27活性的关键残基。Y1H和双荧光素酶实验表明，转录因子（TFs）RcWHY1和RcbZIP24/44/53直接结合RcUGT27启动子，驱动其表达；值得注意的是，RcbZIP24和RcbZIP53形成复合物以增强这种调控。激素处理显示，ABA和MeJA通过这些转录因子显著诱导RcUGT27表达。本研究构建了掌叶覆盆子中K3R生物合成的综合调控网络，为未来分子育种策略和工业化生产提供了宝贵见解。
